name: Dune 45 at sunrise
why: A climb up the sharp crest of a red star dune to watch the first sun light up the Namib, one side bright orange and the other still in shadow.
book: Park permit from the office just inside the Sesriem gate. The gate opens at sunrise and closes at sunset; only guests of the Namibia Wildlife Resorts places inside the gate can reach the dunes for sunrise. Dune 45 is at km 45 of the tarred Sossusvlei road.
water: None at the dune: carry 1 litre each, more if you stay for Sossusvlei.
dangers: Soft sand on a steep, narrow crest: walk on the ridge line, and the way down is faster straight down the slope.
Cold, windy mornings in winter (June to August), then fierce sun: layers, hat and sunscreen.
From October to March the sand is too hot to climb after mid-morning.
turnaround: On the crest by sunrise or a little after; in hot months be back down by 09:00.

points.name: Dune 45 base and parking
points.note: Parking with a few camel thorn trees beside the Sossusvlei road. The path heads straight for the north end of the crest.

points.name: Dune 45 crest
points.note: A high point on the crest of the dune, which stands over 170 m. View over the Tsauchab valley and rows of red dunes. Return the same way.
